name: MILESTONE BOUNDARY: 19 Nov QA-gate chain — verify evidence, quote the verdict, re-forecast
description:
PM CHECKPOINT, not engineering work. Owner: ProjectManager. Runs AFTER the whole 19 Nov chain (last card starts 11:00Z), so it must not start before 12:00Z.

WHY THIS CARD EXISTS
The 19 Nov chain has six cards and no card that asks "did it actually work, and what is the new date?". Without this, a silent failure (again) means another day is lost before anyone notices.

INPUTS TO READ (in this order)
1. `ad1c6bc7` — QA env R2 (max effort, 08:45Z). Did `qa_run_tests(suite="pytest")` return `passed > 0`?
2. `29dfe331` (09:30Z) — pasted command output proving the 16-test suite runs.
3. `40a4c484` (10:05Z) — the QA gate verdict, quoted.
4. `c476e095` (10:30Z) — the commit hash for the 5 staged suite files.
5. `7d3ffd19` (09:00Z) — root-vs-project diff defect explanation.
6. `4966baf0` (08:30Z) — `.codx` untracked + 4 `git rm --cached` paths.

DO
- State the outcome in one line: GREEN (16 passed quoted) / AMBER (suite runs, gate still noisy) / RED (env still broken).
- If GREEN: re-forecast the remaining increments with real dates, and re-date `4173cfd4` (the management decision) with the gate evidence attached.
- If RED for `ad1c6bc7`: do NOT create another retry card. Move it to `user_action_needed`-equivalent (status `onhold` + `request_help`) stating that four agent runs at default tier and one at max tier have failed, and that the remaining work needs a human with shell access to `/home/codx-junior/codx-junior/api/.venv`. That escalation is already pre-approved as the recommendation in the 18 Nov shift report.
- Write the boundary report on the desk board (`Agent: ProjectManager`) in the standing format, `#TL; DR;` first.

ACCEPTANCE
One report exists that answers: did the QA gate run the suite yes/no, with the quoted tool output, plus the next dated increment per remaining card.

HARD NO
No coding, no installing, no editing tests, no committing. This card is verification and re-planning only.
